form.label: SSH Threat Detection Dashboard
form.description: Real-time monitoring of SSH-based attacks and anomalies

search.query: index=linux_secure sourcetype=linux_secure | rex "((?Accepted|Failed) password for (?\S+) from (?\S+))" | search event_type=* | bucket _time span=1h | stats count by _time, event_type | sort _time
index=linux_secure sourcetype=linux_secure "Failed password" | rex "Failed password for (?\S+) from (?\S+)" | stats count by src_ip | sort - count | head 20

index=linux_secure sourcetype=linux_secure "Failed password" | rex "Failed password for (?\S+) from (?\S+)" | lookup geoip src_ip OUTPUT city, country, lat, lon | stats count by src_ip, city, country, lat, lon | geom geoip lat, lon
index=linux_secure sourcetype=linux_secure "Failed password" | rex "Failed password for (?\S+) from (?\S+)" | stats count by target_user | sort - count | head 10

index=linux_secure sourcetype=linux_secure "Failed password" | rex "Failed password for (?\S+) from (?\S+)" | bucket _time span=5m | stats count by src_ip, target_user, _time | where count >= 5 | eval severity = case( count >= 20, "CRITICAL", count >= 10, "HIGH", count >= 5, "MEDIUM" ) | lookup geoip src_ip OUTPUT city, country | sort - _time | table _time, src_ip, target_user, count, severity, city, country

index=linux_secure sourcetype=linux_secure "Accepted password" | rex "Accepted password for (?\S+) from (?\S+)" | lookup geoip src_ip OUTPUT city as src_city, country as src_country, lat, lon | streamstats time_window=1h values(lat) as prev_lat, values(lon) as prev_lon, values(src_city) as prev_city by target_user | eval distance_km = sqrt(pow((lat - prev_lat) * 111.32, 2) + pow((lon - prev_lon) * 111.32 * cos(lat * 3.14159 / 180), 2)) | eval time_diff_hours = (_time - prev_time) / 3600 | eval required_speed = if(time_diff_hours > 0, distance_km / time_diff_hours, 0) | where required_speed > 900 | table _time, target_user, src_ip, src_city, prev_city, distance_km, required_speed
